item.title: GRANBLUE FANTASY: RELINK - ENDLESS RAGNAROK Is Coming To Switch 2 This Summer
item.description: Cygames confirms Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok will land on Nintendo Switch 2 this summer, they will be updating the base game with new bosses, characters, and Switch-exclusive local co-op.

item.title: ROBLOX Has Been Banned In Another Country Amid Ongoing Child Safety Concerns
item.description: Egypt's government has implemented a nationwide ban on Roblox, citing risks to children's morals, exposure to violent content, and unrestricted interactions with strangers.

item.title: DIABLO 4 Season 12 Has Some Secret Content Blizzard Hasn't Told Us About Yet
item.description: Blizzard's Diablo 4 Season 12 PTR notes hint at hidden surprises beyond Killstreaks and Bloodied items, set for reveal near launch. Will the new content make it a good season?

item.title: Embark Studios Teases Two New Games In Development After ARC RAIDERS Profitable Run
item.description: Embark Studios CEO has confirmed there are two new projects in development, crediting ARC Raiders' success for studio growth and stability, the extraction shooter continues to get monthly updates.

item.title: Discord Will Be Locking Full Access Behind A Face Scan Or ID In Upcoming Update
item.description: Discord announced that it will roll out enhanced teen safety features worldwide starting in early March, where users will have to verify adult status through face scans or ID to have full access.

item.title: ARC RAIDERS Latest Duplication Glitch Has Turned Lobbies Into Explosive Nightmares
item.description: A fresh duplication exploit in Arc Raiders is letting players spam infinite Trigger Nades and ziplines, flooding lobbies with chaos and explosions.

item.title: MARVEL TOKON: FIGHTING SOULS New Leak Reveals 20 Character Roster, 64 Player Lobbies On Release
item.description: A new leak on the Steam page for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls reveals the game will have 20 characters, massive 64-player lobbies, single-player Episode Mode on release.

item.title: RUMOR: New STARCRAFT Shooter Game In Development After Blizzard Deal With Nexon
item.description: New reports claim that Nexon has launched a secret StarCraft project under its Shooter Division after their partnership with Blizzard in 2025. Here is what we know so far.

item.title: miHoYo Has Confirmed Four Former GENSHIN IMPACT Employees Were Sent To Prison For Bribery
item.description: miHoYo has revealed that four ex-staffers received prison sentences ranging from six months to one year and four months for abusing positions to take bribes from partners. A fifth was also blacklisted.

item.title: Riot Games Is Downsizing It's 2XKO Development Team After The Game's Launch Performs Poorly
item.description: Riot Games has confirmed a reduction in the 2XKO development team following the fighter's launch, citing insufficient long-term player momentum despite a passionate core audience.
